title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At eight, Crown Princess Pride Royal Ivy realizes she was a Japanese teen reborn into her favorite otome game, destined to become the Wicked Queen who ruins everyone and is killed by a love interest (Seven Seas blurb via MU). She decides to use her 'last boss' powers to protect the love interests and save everyone instead (blurb). Manga of a light novel; discontinued after 3 volumes (MU).
life_message: Power and privilege should be spent serving and protecting others, whatever fate seems to dictate.
